AuditRecord.title: AuditRecord
AuditRecord.description: A user-saved dark pattern and Terms of Service audit report for a domain.

ownerUid.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this audit record.

domain.description: Audited website domain or service name.

grade.description: Computed OpenShield safety grade from A to F.

issuesFound.description: Total number of dark patterns and ToS red flags detected.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the saved audit.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the audit was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the audit was last updated.

UserReview.title: UserReview
UserReview.description: A user's Chrome Web Store extension rating and review.

authorName.description: Public display name of the reviewer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was last updated.

/users/{userId}/audits/{auditId}.description: Stores private dark pattern and ToS audit reports owned by a specific user.

/users/{userId}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Stores Chrome Web Store extension reviews authored by a specific user.
